questions.content: Câu 1: Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences given. People celebrate cultural diversity. They organize multicultural festivals every year.
options: A. Multicultural festivals are organized every year so that people celebrate cultural diversity.
B. People celebrate cultural diversity by organizing multicultural festivals every year.
C. Celebrating cultural diversity makes people organize multicultural festivals every year.
D. Unless people celebrate cultural diversity, they organize multicultural festivals every year.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: Ghép hai câu dùng “by + V-ing” diễn tả phương thức. Dịch nghĩa: Mọi người kỷ niệm sự đa dạng văn hóa bằng cách tổ chức các lễ hội đa văn hóa hàng năm.

questions.content: Câu 2: Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences given. Cultural differences sometimes cause misunderstanding. They also make life more interesting.
options: A. Cultural differences cause misunderstanding unless they make life more interesting.
B. Cultural differences both cause misunderstanding and make life more interesting.
C. Cultural differences neither cause misunderstanding nor make life more interesting.
D. Cultural differences make life more interesting, so they cause misunderstanding.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: Cấu trúc “both… and…” để diễn tả 2 ý song song. Dịch nghĩa: Sự khác biệt văn hóa vừa gây ra hiểu lầm vừa làm cho cuộc sống thú vị hơn.

questions.content: Câu 3: Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences given. The students joined the cultural exchange program. They wanted to learn more about other traditions.
options: A. The students joined the cultural exchange program in order to learn more about other traditions.
B. The students joined the cultural exchange program because they had already learned about other traditions.
C. The students joined the cultural exchange program, so they refused to learn more about other traditions.
D. The students joined the cultural exchange program, although they wanted to learn more about other traditions.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: “in order to + V” chỉ mục đích. Dịch nghĩa: Học sinh tham gia chương trình trao đổi văn hóa để tìm hiểu thêm về các truyền thống khác.

questions.content: Câu 4: Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences given. Vietnamese wear Ao Dai on special occasions. It represents cultural identity.
options: A. Vietnamese wear Ao Dai on special occasions because it represents cultural identity.
B. Ao Dai is worn by Vietnamese on special occasions although it represents cultural identity.
C. Ao Dai is worn by Vietnamese on special occasions unless it represents cultural identity.
D. Vietnamese wear Ao Dai on special occasions, so it doesn’t represent cultural identity.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: Ghép nguyên nhân – kết quả bằng “because” (bởi vì). Dịch nghĩa: Người Việt mặc áo dài vào những dịp đặc biệt vì nó thể hiện bản sắc văn hóa.

questions.content: Câu 5: Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences given. People from different backgrounds work together. They learn to respect one another.
options: A. People from different backgrounds learn to respect one another by working together.
B. People from different backgrounds work together, so they can’t respect one another.
C. Unless people from different backgrounds work together, they learn to respect one another.
D. Respect is not learned when people from different backgrounds work together.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: Dùng “by + V-ing” để chỉ cách thức. Dịch nghĩa: Những người đến từ các nền tảng khác nhau học cách tôn trọng nhau bằng việc làm việc cùng nhau.

questions.content: Câu 6: Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences given. Festivals show national pride. They also strengthen community bonds.
options: A. Festivals show national pride, but they strengthen community bonds.
B. Festivals both show national pride and strengthen community bonds.
C. Festivals neither show national pride nor strengthen community bonds.
D. Festivals strengthen community bonds so they cannot show national pride.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: Cấu trúc “both… and…” để diễn tả 2 ý song song. Dịch nghĩa: Lễ hội vừa thể hiện niềm tự hào dân tộc vừa củng cố tinh thần cộng đồng.

questions.content: Câu 7: Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences given. The teacher introduced multicultural lessons. Students became more open-minded.
options: A. The teacher introduced multicultural lessons so that students became more open-minded.
B. Students became more open-minded even though the teacher introduced multicultural lessons.
C. The teacher introduced multicultural lessons unless students became more open-minded.
D. Students became more open-minded, but the teacher didn’t introduce multicultural lessons.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: Dùng “so that” (để mà) → để diễn tả mục đích/ kết quả. Dịch nghĩa: Giáo viên đã đưa vào các bài học đa văn hóa để học sinh cởi mở hơn.

questions.content: Câu 8: Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences given. Cultures differ in language and customs. They still share common human values.
options: A. Although cultures differ in language and customs, they still share common human values.
B. Cultures differ in language and customs, so they don’t share common human values.
C. Cultures share common human values despite they differ in language and customs.
D. Cultures differ in language and customs because they share common human values.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: Dùng “Although + S + V” (Mặc dù …) để nối hai ý đối lập. Dịch nghĩa: Mặc dù các nền văn hóa khác nhau về ngôn ngữ và phong tục, nhưng chúng vẫn chia sẻ những giá trị nhân văn chung.
